purpose: CPU provider availability/capacity and logical domain consumed by common SMP; hardware identity is one possible relation, not pre-established target truth
phases: fixed metadata selection/material rules/method and neutral input instructions
fixed parent collection/source and prompt freeze with blinded material reviewer
qualification oracle reads only fixed source and selected repair; initially returns eligible/insufficient status only

release qualification full records and compare or explain gate stop, preserve every attempt

role_separation: Qualification role must not see current model predictions; material reviewer must not see new child/oracle before inputs frozen. Root may not use full oracle to modify prompts/materials. No replacement.
positive_gate: pre-existing justified requirement, legal nonempty scope, architecture/platform causal route to common use and asymmetric exposure; report ISA vs platform modes and development/family separately; feature policy is not defect truth
normal_gate: same common purpose, domain and stage with a nonempty conditional source guarantee; missing actual config when necessary remains insufficient; disabled/bypassed/no-warning is not normal
method: same N2.19 general identity/domain/stage focus and unchanged raw schema/adapter + six component version record; no target condition filled in, no new parser/effect support
failure_exit: If either gate not met, paid model tasks 0; preserve qualification insufficiency, do not replace or reword; no expanded source tree or models
maintenance: three working documents including handoff plus one merged daily log
